svg.title: Capabilities and interests
svg.desc: Capabilities: RAG pipelines; agentic AI with tool calling; full-stack with React, Node.js and FastAPI; desktop apps with Tauri and Rust; local-first systems. Beside it, a three-slide carousel that changes every four seconds: 1 of 3 Personal Interests (Chess, Puzzles, Card Magic); 2 of 3 Personal Interests (Horology, Iron Man, AI/ML, Philosophy); 3 of 3 The Pocket (Reading Gödel, Escher, Bach; Studying Attention Is All You Need; Playing the Sicilian Defense; Obsessing over the A. Lange & Söhne Datograph; Building something with LLMs and memory; Thinking about the Ship of Theseus).

g.text: I play chess while the world plays
Every problem is a scrambled state. I
Misdirection is an art. So is debugging.
